newsitem.title: USA: CME lumber futures close mixed.
newsitem.headline: CME lumber futures close mixed.

text.p: CME lumber futures drifted down from early gains and finished mixed in light trade.

Initial local short covering lacked followthrough and futures drifted down the remainder of the day on scattered commission house and commercial selling. Expectations that demand for lumber would improve around the holiday failed to materialize as cash markets remained slow, they said.
Cash sources cited continued larger offerings of wood at generally lower prices.
Lumber closed off $1.60 per tbf to up $2.00 with July up $0.10 at $393.90 and September off $1.40 at $382.00 per tbf.
